description: Each Chromium build the scan browser has run or can run, with its version tag's commit in chromium/chromium. Chromium stops applying its built-in HSTS preload list 70 days after the build time IsBuildTimely() compares (net/http/transport_security_state.cc). That build time is taken to be the version tag's commit time, an assumption one lapse has confirmed so far (153.0.8010.12 on 2026-11-03). Each entry was read with gh api repos/chromium/chromium/git/ref/tags/<version> and then the commit it names (committer date). scripts/chromium-hsts-preload-cutoff.mjs estimates each cutoff from these; lib/chromium-build-times.test.ts requires an entry for the Chromium the installed playwright-core bundles.
